tasks_completed.description: Replaced absolute-path symlink .claude/skills/google-maps -> /root/travel-planner/.claude/commands/scripts/google-maps with a RELATIVE-path symlink -> ../commands/scripts/google-maps, and staged it for git tracking
tasks_completed.changes: readlink output changed from '/root/travel-planner/.claude/commands/scripts/google-maps' (absolute, broken on clean checkouts under a different prefix) to '../commands/scripts/google-maps' (relative; portable). Used `ln -sfn` (atomic replace; no `rm` invoked — `rm` is blocked by pretool-bash-safety.sh hook). Then `git add` staged the new symlink (was untracked per `git ls-files .claude/skills/` showing only gaode-maps before).
tasks_completed.rationale: AC5 / OBJ-6 forbids the absolute-symlink-commit branch. Option (a) — relative symlink — chosen over option (b) — path-constant migration in fetch-images-batch.py — because it is the minimum diff (1 symlink, 0 Python lines changed) and aligns with the existing `.claude/skills/gaode-maps` precedent (which itself is currently absolute, but that is W3-out-of-scope per the write-set boundary).

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: 46a46d5 — migrated helper to .claude/commands/scripts/google-maps/ but only added a local untracked absolute-path symlink at .claude/skills/google-maps, leaving fetch-images-batch.py's hardcoded `.claude/skills/google-maps/scripts/places.py` path dependent on a per-host absolute target that does not exist on a clean checkout under a different filesystem prefix
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Symlink was created with an absolute path (`/root/travel-planner/.claude/commands/scripts/google-maps`) and never committed. A clean checkout — or any checkout under a non-default path — yields a broken symlink, so fetch-images-batch.py's `_assert_helper_paths_exist()` raises FileNotFoundError before any image fetch can proceed.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Relative-path symlink (`../commands/scripts/google-maps`) resolves correctly under ANY checkout prefix because the relationship between `.claude/skills/` and `.claude/commands/scripts/` is constant within the repo. Staging the symlink ensures it travels with the repo on clean checkouts.

dev.qa_notes: To verify: (1) `readlink .claude/skills/google-maps` returns `../commands/scripts/google-maps` (relative, NOT absolute); (2) `git ls-files .claude/skills/google-maps` returns the symlink (staged or committed); (3) clean-checkout portability test — copy `.claude/` and `scripts/` to a new prefix outside `/root/travel-planner` (e.g., `/tmp/portability-test-X`) and run `python3 scripts/fetch-images-batch.py <some-slug> 0 0` — should exit 0 with no FileNotFoundError. This was performed and PASSED at /tmp/portability-test-878957.
